description.value:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

target.value: 1 living creature or 1 willing undead creature

description.value:
Extending a finger, you fire a beam of void energy that weakens the life force of any creature it touches. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Heightened (+2) The persistent void damage increases by 1d8 on a success, or by 2d8 on a failure or critical failure.

Trigger A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

Requirements You are not encumbered.

You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Trigger The attack roll for a Strike targeting you fails or critically fails.

You deftly step aside and gently redirect an attack. You redirect the triggering attack to a creature of your choice that is adjacent to you and within the attack's reach or maximum range. The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

Living creatures in this area take @Damage[8d6[void]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect]). A creature that fails this save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh] for 1 round (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2] for 1 round and then dazzled for 1 round on a critical failure).

description.value: The strigoi springs into combat faster than foes can react. On the first round of combat, if it rolls Deception or Stealth for initiative, creatures that haven't acted are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg] to it.

If the strigoi's next action is to Cast a Spell, the spell gains the subtle trait, hiding the manifestations that would usually give away its spellcasting. The trait hides only the spell's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects.

Requirements The strigoi is adjacent to an enemy.

Attempt an Acrobatics check against the Reflex DC of an enemy adjacent to the strigoi.

Critical Success The strigoi moves through the enemy's space to an unoccupied space on the other side. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. The strigoi can't move farther than its Speed and must end movement adjacent to the enemy. It then makes a melee Strike against that enemy, and the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg] against the Strike.

Success As critical success, but the enemy isn't off-guard against the Strike.

Failure The strigoi remains in its original space but can still Strike.

Critical Failure The strigoi neither moves nor Strikes.

You are difficult for one or more creatures to see due to thick fog or some other obscuring feature. You can be concealed to some creatures but not others. While concealed, you can still be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}, but you're tougher to target. A creature that you're concealed from must succeed at a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:5] when targeting you with an attack, spell, or other effect. If the check fails, you aren't affected. Area effects aren't subject to this flat check.
